notes.title: Brothel of Darrkness info and release date update
notes.content:
While the original plan to release [b]Brothel of Darkness[/b] was the 15th of April, for the [b]request of the comminity we are implemented body presets[/b] for the protagonist, what you can choose at the beginning of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43538211/98dc8fb06d53fa66a01e61173750447ee97187a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43538211/ac7cbaf948a49cfea6f81222a0be5768c88623db.png[/img]

The new presets are already implemented, it will make a small delay what we have to spend for testing.

[b]Brothel of Darkness will be released at the end of April, latest early May.[/b]
